description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions related to the sidebar categories and channels in the Mattermost application, including category types, sorting options, and validation logic.

classes.name: SidebarCategory
classes.description: Represents a sidebar category with properties like ID, user ID, team ID, sort order, sorting mode, type, display name, muted and collapsed states.

classes.name: SidebarCategoryWithChannels
classes.description: Extends SidebarCategory to include associated channel IDs.

classes.name: OrderedSidebarCategories
classes.description: Contains sorted categories with their channel IDs and order.

classes.name: SidebarChannel
classes.description: Represents a channel within a sidebar category, including channel ID, user ID, category ID, and sort order.

methods.name: ChannelIds
methods.description: Returns the list of channel IDs associated with a SidebarCategoryWithChannels instance.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Custom JSON marshaling for SidebarCategoryType and SidebarCategorySorting types.

methods.name: IsValidCategoryId
methods.description: Validates if a given string is a valid category ID, either by pattern matching or by using IsValidId.
